answer: Structural repair manuals cap how many doublers may sit near one frame, because stacked patches change how load flows. Cap identities the same way: limit how many new keys any one sponsor can vouch for per period, and require each to carry its own graded record before vouching for others. An operator building an island of linked keys hits the limit quickly. Like a lotus with one root, the plume of new accounts traces back to a single sponsor and is counted once.
